source.modifications: Bilinear sampling to 241×185 backdrop grid; negative values clamped to 0 m; voids flagged invalid, not filled. No imagery, buildings, bathymetry or Google data.
source.purpose: DISTANT VISUAL BACKGROUND ONLY. Not suitable for collision, terrain navigation or street-level elevation.

notes: SRTM radar surface circa 2000; includes canopy/building biases and coarse shoreline.
Grid is about 120×133 m at Naples; does not depict modern facades or replace gameplay terrain.
Only draw outside the verified city footprint; skip sea-only and missing-data cells.
